# Export cases: <file, relative to the repository root> <backends...>
# Each is exported body-only, without evaluating Babel (backends: ascii
# html latex md); the output is <basename>.<txt|html|tex|md> here, with
# the repository root in paths written as @ROOT@/.
#
# A subset, to keep the fixtures small (~1 MB): the export-heavy tutorials
# with every backend, a few others with some. Left out on purpose:
#   13-links, 14-footnotes  Emacs aborts: they show a broken link and an
#                           undefined footnote on purpose
#   tutorial html           Emacs aborts on a fuzzy link it can't resolve
#   21-images-latex latex   Emacs asks whether to download a remote image
#                           (impossible in batch)
#   the other examples      size only (they are mostly outline, agenda and
#                           editing tutorials; add them here when needed)
examples/00-index.org             ascii html latex md
examples/02-markup.org            ascii html latex md
examples/03-lists.org             ascii html latex md
examples/10-sparse-trees.org      html
examples/15-tables.org            ascii latex
examples/17-babel.org             ascii md
examples/19-export.org            ascii html latex md
examples/20-timers-reminders.org  ascii html latex md
examples/21-images-latex.org      ascii md
examples/22-extras.org            ascii html latex md
examples/tutorial.org             ascii
